test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In MS PowerPoint's Slide Master view, what is the primary benefit of customising the top-level master slide versus individual layout masters?

options.text: Customising the top-level master ensures consistency of universal elements across all slide layouts
The top-level master is only relevant when exporting the presentation to other formats
Individual layout masters cannot be edited unless the top-level master is modified first
Changes to the top-level master overrides all formatting on individual layout masters

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Customising the top-level master ensures consistency of universal elements across all slide layouts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **MS PowerPoint**, the **Slide Master View** allows users to edit the slide master, which controls the overall design and layout of the presentation.
